text:
You need a ProEst database that is residential-remodeling specific, supports unit and assembly-based estimating, and reflects current vendor and subcontractor pricing so your team can start using the system as soon as possible.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be a strong fit for this setup work because I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, dashboard building, data cleaning, and data visualization. While I haven’t worked in ProEst specifically, I have built structured reporting and modeling solutions that required organizing messy data into clean, reliable systems that people could actually use for daily decisions.

One relevant project was a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work consolidated 14 reports into 1 and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That experience is directly relevant to building a database that is organized, consistent, and ready for practical use across a business workflow.

Another project was a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners. I built a three-site expansion model with best, base, and worst cases for patient volume and staffing. The model compared 3 sites and helped identify the option projected to pay back in 14 months. That project required careful handling of assumptions, scenario structure, and financial logic—skills that translate well to estimating databases where accuracy and maintainability matter.

For your ProEst setup, I would focus on helping structure the data so it is usable for assembly estimating and take-off workflows, with clean categories, consistent naming, and pricing fields that can be maintained as vendors or subcontractors change. I’m comfortable working through data cleanup, spreadsheet organization, and SQL-based structure design to support a dependable estimating foundation.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing your current item list, identifying gaps and inconsistencies, and helping you map it into a cleaner residential remodeling database structure that is ready for import and ongoing use.
